definitions.explanation: The academic department at a university that teaches engineering disciplines such as mechanical, electrical, civil, and computer engineering.

examples.japanese: {工学部|こうがくぶ}に{合格|ごうかく}した。
examples.english: I was accepted into the engineering faculty.

examples.japanese: {工学部|こうがくぶ}は{男子|だんし}{学生|がくせい}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: The engineering department has many male students.

examples.japanese: {工学部|こうがくぶ}の{卒業生|そつぎょうせい}は、メーカーやIT{企業|きぎょう}に{就職|しゅうしょく}する{人|ひと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Many engineering graduates find employment at manufacturing companies and IT firms.

notes:
A compound of {工学|こうがく} (engineering) and {学部|がくぶ} (faculty). One of the most popular faculties at Japanese universities, especially for students aiming at careers in manufacturing, technology, and infrastructure — industries central to the Japanese economy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {工学部|こうがくぶ}{機械|きかい}{工学科|こうがくか}: mechanical engineering department
- {工学部|こうがくぶ}{電気|でんき}{電子|でんし}{工学科|こうがくか}: electrical and electronic engineering department
- {工学部|こうがくぶ}を{受験|じゅけん}する: to take the engineering faculty entrance exam

RELATED TERMS:
- {理学部|りがくぶ}: faculty of science (pure sciences)
- {理工学部|りこうがくぶ}: faculty of science and engineering
- {工学|こうがく}: engineering
- {学部|がくぶ}: faculty; department
